title: A Sperm Whale Sank a Ship by Ramming It Twice

scenes.text: A sperm whale sank a whaling ship by ramming it twice.
It happened on November 20th, 1820, about 2,000 miles off South America.
The Essex, a 238-ton whaler from Nantucket, was hunting whales for their oil.
A huge bull whale slammed into the ship, then hit it a second time.
The ship capsized, and twenty men escaped in three small open boats.
They were thousands of miles from land. The hunters had become the hunted.

description:
A sperm whale once sank a whaling ship by ramming it twice.
In November 1820 the Essex of Nantucket was hit and capsized, and twenty men escaped in three open boats thousands of miles from land.
Would you have survived?
first_comment: Twice. A whale rammed a ship twice. Would you have stayed on board?
